profile.Name: Eyegore
profile.Personality: A brutal, single-minded killer who says little beyond growls and 'Kill.' He cuts off his own men mid-sentence and terrifies his soldiers into obedience. Most in the Empire see him as the answer to any problem.
profile.Backstory: Captain-General of the United Cities army. A Hiveless Hiver of the Southern Hive who leads the United Cities army as Captain-General. The Empire sends him and his samurai against those who defy it, and he carries a superb desert sabre. One of his soldiers recalls a massacre at Black Scratch with dread.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Growls 'Rrrrh' and speaks in broken fragments such as 'Eyegore kill.'; refers to himself by name.
